steps.label: cut english muffin
steps.recipe_text: Cut -Cut the English muffin into two pieces with a knife

steps.label: coat ramekin with spray
steps.recipe_text: Coat -Coat a 6-oz. ramekin cup with cooking spray

steps.label: pour egg into ramekin
steps.recipe_text: Pour-Pour 1 egg into the ramekin cup

steps.label: microwave ramekin 30 seconds
steps.recipe_text: Microwave-Microwave the ramekin cup uncovered on high for 30 seconds

steps.label: microwave egg until set
steps.recipe_text: Microwave -Continue to Microwave for 15-30 more seconds or until the egg is almost set

steps.label: top cup with salsa
steps.recipe_text: Top -Top cup with 1 tablespoon of salsa

steps.label: line muffin with lettuce
steps.recipe_text: Line -Line the bottom piece of the English muffin with lettuce

steps.label: sprinkle cheese on cup
steps.recipe_text: sprinkle -sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cheese on cup

steps.label: microwave until cheese melts
steps.recipe_text: Microwave -Microwave just until cheese melts, about 10 seconds

steps.label: place egg over lettuce
steps.recipe_text: Place -Place the egg from the cup over the lettuce

steps.label: replace english muffin top
steps.recipe_text: replace -replace the top of the English muffin
